summary: This bill mandates the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to continue its Climate and Health program, or any successor, to translate climate science for governments and communities, create decision support tools, and lead public health planning for climate change, authorizing $110 million annually for its funding starting in fiscal year 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to continue and fund the CDC's Climate and Health program, which focuses on the public health impacts of climate change. This directly relates to public health infrastructure and preventative care, which are components of healthcare.
